authorization: User requested relabeling where necessary and continuation toward model improvement. Existing lower-front landmark definition is retained.

method.root_prior_exposure: Primary assistant knew prior label/model review history. New case scoring was not read before these decisions were frozen. This is not a completely model-blind study.
method.case_selection: Previously recorded ambiguous points, not a random sample.

accepted_changes.reason: Both reviewers locate the saved point below-left of the exposed wax turn. Select reviewer B's image-only integer representative; reviewer A independently chose a point two pixels farther right on the same arc. Do not average predictions or snap to the bright inner boundary.
accepted_changes.confidence: High agreement that old point misses the required wax turn; moderate precision of the new representative.

accepted_changes.reason: Both reviewers reject the saved point on dark material left of the wax. A replacement near the hand has disputed physical-corner visibility, only about one to three native pixels of possible free lower arc, and no reliably established independent lower edge. Under the observed-point rule, mark unlocatable instead of certifying a guessed coordinate.
accepted_changes.confidence: High agreement that the old point is unsupported; physical visibility of the alternative remains disputed. v0 records inability to locate reliably, not proof that the corner is hidden.

retained_points.reason: Saved point follows the darker outer wax turn; coordinate differences within a rounded arc do not compel a shift.
Post-label tracing confirms the saved point on the outer shaded wax contour. Reviewer A corrected its initial brighter-inner-boundary interpretation.
Saved point follows the visible lower-left turn; no supported replacement is needed.
Saved point identifies the upper partial front's exposed lower-left step; opposite endpoint remains missing.

visibility_dissent.reviewer_a: A small free curve may expose the actual corner; initial (463,664) revised after tracing to approximately (459,663), v2, reduced confidence.
visibility_dissent.reviewer_b: The short curve does not establish the actual bottom edge independently of the hand; use000.
visibility_dissent.root_adjudication: Use000 because the observed-point contract requires a reliably locatable actual corner. The old point is unsupported under either interpretation. Preserve the object and box; no invented replacement.

limits: The new integer point is a reproducible visual representative, not subpixel physical truth.
